source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
In your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), any number of your units can start this **[action](vsdata:core-rule/performing-actions)**, no 2 within the same **[terrain area](vsdata:core-rule/terrain)**. To start it, a unit must be either:

- in range of an **[objective](vsdata:core-rule/objectives)** other than your **[home objective](vsdata:core-rule/objectives)**
- within a terrain area outside your deployment zone not yet **trapped** by you

It completes at once: the terrain area is **trapped** and you set an **operation marker** of yours within it.

Open point: the rule does not say what becomes **trapped** when a unit qualifies only by being in range of an objective while outside every terrain area.

openQuestions: It is unclear what gets trapped when a unit qualifies only by being in range of an objective while outside every terrain area.
